verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is in the Outbound product, where "campaign cadences with scheduling windows control when outreach happens." That is a first-party, time-based recurring capability, but it is limited to outbound campaigns. Nothing shows general recurring scheduling for workflows, simulation batches, or other jobs, including via the MCP server. missing for 10: general cron-style or recurring scheduling of arbitrary workflows/jobs, schedule management via API/MCP for AI-native use, detailed docs on recurrence options, independent or hands-on corroboration.
